headline: Tesla & SpaceX Invest $16.8B in Texas chip factory
summary: The 'Terafab' facility will span over 100 million square feet and aims to produce advanced logic and memory chips for AI and autonomous systems.
details: Tesla and SpaceX are jointly developing an advanced chip factory called 'Terafab' in Grimes County, Texas, with an initial investment of $16.8 billion. Elon Musk described it as potentially the largest and most valuable building on Earth.

The planned facility will feature over 100 million square feet of manufacturing space, aiming to produce advanced logic and memory devices. This includes chips optimized for edge computing and inference for Tesla's Optimus robots and Cybercabs, as well as high-power chips for SpaceX's space-based data centers.

The project is driven by Musk's vision for a future requiring immense computing power for AI, robotaxis, and satellite data centers. SpaceX alone has indicated potential multi-phase investments of up to $119 billion.
Intel is also contributing to the Terafab project, though the specifics of their involvement remain undisclosed. The factory is expected to create at least 3,000 jobs in Grimes and Brazos Counties.

The announcement has faced some local opposition, with residents raising concerns about tax breaks and transparency during a recent county meeting. However, local school officials expressed optimism about the opportunities the project may bring.
